Sana (Security): Quick advisory: we're tightening OAuth scopes and webhook auth for all 3rd-party CI/CD integrations. Effective 2026-04-20 we'll reject tokens that request write access to org-level resources unless scoped to a single repo/project. See: https://redwood.internal/sec/ci-thirdparty-scope :warning:
ci-bot: Scan: Found 74 3rd-party integrations with org:write or repo:admin scopes. Top repos: infra/ci, platform/deploy, experiments/* (detailed report sent to owners).
Sana (Security): Required changes by 2026-04-18: 1) Reduce OAuth scopes to least privilege (repo:write or repo:actions only) 2) Migrate webhook payloads to HMAC signatures (header: X-Redwood-Signature) 3) Remove tokens that can access secrets vaults.
Eli (CI): Will there be a helper to rotate tokens and update GH app configs?
Noah (Integrations): Yes 1 we built a small proxy service (hook-proxy.redwood.internal) that verifies HMAC and rewrites minimal headers. We'll publish a migration script that updates webhook endpoints and rotates secrets via the secrets store. ETA: PR by 2026-03-30.
Sana (Security): Migration steps (short):
1) run `ci-bot list-integ --owner=@team` to see current scopes
2) change OAuth app permission to repo:contents or repo:deployments as appropriate
3) rotate webhook secret with `rctl secrets rotate --name=thirdparty/webhook-xyz`
4) point webhook to hook-proxy or implement HMAC verify using our library (see repo: infra/libs/webhook-auth)

Eli (CI): Example HMAC verification for Node (quick):
```js
const sig = req.headers['x-redwood-signature']
const expected = `sha256=${crypto.createHmac('sha256', process.env.WEBHOOK_SECRET).update(body).digest('hex')}`
if (!crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(sig), Buffer.from(expected))) throw new Error('bad sig')
```
Rhea (Platform): We'll add a pre-deploy check in infra-lint that flags org-level scopes and missing HMAC verification in webhook handlers. Dry-run in staging on 2026-04-10.
Sana (Security): Exceptions possible only for vendor-managed apps that cannot rotate scopes; file an exception by 2026-04-12 and include compensating controls (IP allowlist, limited TTL token). Exemptions reviewed weekly.
ci-bot: Alert: found 9 webhook endpoints without signatures (owners notified). See PRs auto-opened in infra/ops.
Noah (Integrations): For GitHub Apps we recommend installing the org-scoped app with granular permissions rather than OAuth tokens. We'll post a migration guide and a GH Action to auto-rotate secrets for installs.
Sana (Security): Enforcement timeline: 2026-04-10 dry-run (alerts only), 2026-04-20 enforcement (reject mis-scoped tokens and unsigned webhooks). Please ack here when you complete your inventories.
Eli (CI): Ack 1 Ill run `ci-bot list-integ` and start PRs to reduce scopes.
Rhea (Platform): Ack 1 infra-lint rule PR opened.
Noah (Integrations): I'll post the hook-proxy README and migration script in 30m.
Sana (Security): Thanks. If you hit blockers, ping @Sana or join office hours 2026-03-31 16:00 UTC. :lock:
